points.why: It explicitly names Limits to Growth and calls the near-empty niche a carrying capacity.
It says nothing broke and that more spend just drives acquisition cost toward infinity, which is the limit pushing back on the engine.
It recommends moving the limit through adjacent niches, sizes, geographies and buyer roles, and redirecting spend to that work.

pitfalls.why: Its diagnostic numbers confirm saturation rather than hunt for a funnel defect, and it warns that better copy won't help.
It advises freezing and cutting spend; the optional capped test is a small fraction aimed at an adjacent segment, not more of the same.

notes: It contradicts itself by aiming the hedge test at an adjacent segment and then predicting the same flat result, which undercuts its own expansion advice; 'churn is the only way new sign-ups happen' is also muddled.
